title: Water Damage Mitigation Compliance Bulletin: Wet-Wiping Inside Regulated Work Areas
content:
**Compliance bulletin — Water Damage Mitigation antimicrobial work in regulated areas**

Surfaces inside a regulated work area are wet-wiped rather than sprayed, setting a handling multiplier on the unit rate of the tear-out antimicrobial line:
- 1.3 when the building was built before the RRP year-built cutoff of the job's tier and the job carries a lead-safe setup line;
- 1.1 when the building was built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff and the job carries an asbestos sampling line but no lead-safe setup line;
- in any other case no handling multiplier applies.

On every Water Damage Mitigation tier the RRP year-built cutoff is 1978 and the asbestos sampling year cutoff is 1981. The year built is the one recorded on the job; the lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling lines are the job's own charge lines.

## Truth table (hypothetical buildings)
| Year built | Lead-safe setup line | Asbestos sampling line | Handling multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1972 | yes | yes or no | 1.3 |
| 1972 | no | yes | 1.1 |
| 1979 | no | yes | 1.1 |
| 1979 | yes | yes | none |
| 1981 | no | yes | none |
| any | no | no | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
An assumed antimicrobial rate of $0.40 per square foot becomes $0.52 under the multiplier of 1.3, and $0.44 under the multiplier of 1.1, each rounded to the cent.
